threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think bus times are *suggestions*, not a lifestyle choice. Buses here are more like rare Pokémon—always just out of reach.
Caught the 333 last night, a guy was loudly explaining to a pigeon why he'd never date a cat. Bus driver didn't even blink.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I spotted a group of elderly men in the park, arguing passionately about the best kebab in town while sharing tea. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a döner at 3 AM while listening to live street performances. The blend of flavors and sounds is unparalleled.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can name the taco truck parked on 24th that’s been there longer than most of the new cafes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week I watched a guy try to board the 19 Polk with a pet iguana on his shoulder. Muni riders just shrugged and let it happen.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the ‘Barcelona vibe’ is all beach and Gaudí. Try hearing the locals jamming in the plaça at midnight—pure magic that’s easily missed.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they struggle to understand the metro map—especially when they try to use their phones while moving.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube'—locals just say 'the Overground' if they even bother. It’s the little things that give you away.
Last night on the 78, a guy serenaded the whole bus with acoustic covers. The driver didn’t even flinch. Only in Bermondsey, I swear.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a group of friends using an old tram stop for a barbecue, complete with a portable speaker and disco lights. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you catch a bus that stops for a pop-up art show in the middle of the street. They just block traffic and let it happen.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid BART during delays but still complain about Muni’s dog incidents like it’s a personal affront.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni near Civic Center today and a dog just settled down on the tracks like it owned the place. Classic San Francisco chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think the plaça is just for photos. They miss the locals using it as a godsend for kids' soccer games on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their confusion at the festa major: they’re still chowing down on churros while the locals are already on to the next round of vermut.
